$comment: Model-name rewrites applied to vendored upstream files, in order. Each rule is a literal find/replace scoped to upstream paths by glob. `count` is the exact number of replacements the rule must make across its files; a mismatch fails the sync so upstream changes are never rewritten blindly. Team models: each member runs Claude Code (Opus 5.5, max effort). So every judgment, prose, and panel role is `inherit-parent`: it runs on the member's own agent, and panels get their independent opinions from separate runs. Code delegates are the exception the owner chose: they run on `sonnet` (Claude Sonnet 5.5), or `haiku` (Claude Haiku 5.5) for trivial mechanical edits. An explicit model name survives only as an example a user can type, and a GPT name is always `gpt-6-sol-high`.

rules.from: Families go by prefix, and the longest matching prefix wins: `claude-fable-*`, `claude-*`, and `gemini-*`. Drop a leading `cursor-` before you compare.
rules.to: Families go by prefix, and the longest matching prefix wins: `claude-*` and `gpt-*`.

rules.from: Map each default slug with the rows above: `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` is `opus xhigh`, `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast` is `opus high`, `claude-fable-5-2-max` is `fable max`, and `gemini-4-carbon-high` is `inherit-parent`.
rules.to: Map each default slug with the rows above. A default of `inherit-parent` stays `inherit-parent`.

rules.from: With the default pool, a Claude parent gets `gemini-4-carbon-high`. A parent from any other vendor gets `claude-fable-5-2-high` first, then `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`.
rules.to: With the default pool, a Claude parent gets `gpt-6-sol-high`. A parent from any other vendor gets `claude-opus-5-5-max` first.

rules.from: The hardest changes (cross-cutting design, gnarly concurrency, subtle algorithms) go to your `hardest tasks` model (default `claude-fable-5-2-max`), whether the task needs judgment on vague intent or is a precisely specified sequence of steps to execute to the letter. Trivial mechanical edits go to your `swarm workers` model (default `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`). Review and design panels default to one runner each on `claude-fable-5-2-high`, `claude-opus-5-5-high-fast`, and `gemini-4-carbon-high`.
rules.to: A feature, refactor, bug fix, perf fix, hillclimb step, or one of the hardest changes (cross-cutting design, gnarly concurrency, subtle algorithms) goes to `sonnet` (Claude Sonnet 5.5). A trivial mechanical edit (a rename, a move, a formatting or one-line fix, or steps specified to the letter with nothing to decide) goes to `haiku` (Claude Haiku 5.5), the `trivial edits` line. The Task tool takes these aliases, not version slugs. Review and design panels default to one runner each on `inherit-parent`, `inherit-parent`, and `inherit-parent`.

rules.from: Fable (`claude-fable-*`) is its own family, apart from the other Claude models.

Gemini has no xhigh, max, or fast slug, so a Gemini subagent runs at high, such as `gemini-4-carbon-high`, whenever the job calls for high or above. Fable 5.2 has no fast slug, so an urgent Fable 5.2 subagent runs at standard speed and keeps its level.

code delegates (feature, refactoring, bug fix, perf, hillclimb), prose, and judgment go to opus 5.5, while the hardest changes go to fable 5.2. the default panel is fable 5.2 / opus 5.5 / gemini 4 carbon.
rules.to: code delegates (feature, refactoring, bug fix, perf, hillclimb) and the hardest changes run on `sonnet` (Claude Sonnet 5.5), and trivial mechanical edits on `haiku` (Claude Haiku 5.5). prose, judgment, and every seat of the default panel run on your current coding agent's model.
